text: Phase 2 complete. 30 JVM and 32 Scala.js tests pass, including 9 ViewLaws tests. select/slice/narrow/reverse/permutation/newAxis/squeeze/broadcastTo/reshapeView share storage; copy/flattenCopy always allocate; contiguous is identity-or-copy. Canonical Slice and negative-axis contracts are enforced. reshapeView implements checked source-block coalescing and target partitioning, rejects non-singleton broadcast axes, and handles canonical empty targets. Algorithm documented in docs/views.md.
